title: Correct Final Answers
description: Essential Criteria: Provide the correct expressions for the intensity at the screen for each case (a-e).

title: Explanation of Interference
description: Important Criteria: Explain the presence or absence of interference terms in cases (c), (d), and (e).

title: Single-Slit Intensity
description: Important Criteria: Clearly state the intensity contributions from each slit when only one is open.

title: Effect of Spin States
description: Important Criteria: Discuss how the spin states affect the interference and intensity in cases (d) and (e).

title: Graphical Representation
description: Optional Criteria: Provide rough graphs showing the relative number of detected electrons for each case.

title: Low Intensity Explanation
description: Optional Criteria: Explain the implications of low intensity on the behavior of electrons passing through the apparatus.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: Watch for sign mistakes in the intensity equations provided.

title: Missing Interference Terms
description: Pitfall Criteria: Ensure that the explanation includes the correct treatment of interference terms where applicable.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Check for consistency in the units used for intensity across different cases.
